title: In this town, everyone is born with a number

lines.text: In this town, everyone is born with a number above their head.
My brother Zeebra is a seven.
My mom Luna is a nine.
And my dad Zip? A perfect ten.
The higher your number, the better your life.
But me? I have been a zero since the day I was born.
Until one night, every number in town started dropping.
Because my number was going up.
And then, the tower said my name.
